scope: All 229 lesson-explanation records / 899 app-authored paragraphs. Alias decisions are display-only; quotations, prayers, Scripture, bibliographic titles and saved annotation anchors retain their stored wording.
matchingRules: Prefer longest explicit full name, then exact paragraph override, then source-specific short author/subject alias. Never infer an unknown name from a nearby source list alone.
Short-name matching is case-sensitive: lowercase mark is a verb, not St. Mark. The same principle excludes ordinary words such as job and grace.
Source-ID context is not universal when a paragraph compares authors. paragraphAliases records the actual context of the current editorial text.
Skip existing titled prefixes and avoid double St.; preserve appropriate Theotokos / Mother of God wording instead of prefixing every Mary with St.
Exclude Bible book-and-number references, King James Version, non-person titles, places and plural peoples. Scripture previews keep ownership of Bible reference markup.
A bare John, Cyril, Gregory, Martin, Moses, Isaac, Mary or Philip must never be mapped globally across the application.
Saint profile names themselves may stay in the established UI title style; app-authored prose requires the saintly honorific when referring to a canonized person.
